title: Midweek microwindow deployment playlist and release notes seed
body:
Purpose
This is a lightweight, midweek microwindow deployment playlist intended for low-risk feature flips and small capacity patches. The doc mixes a concrete rollout calendar, an explicit day-of checklist, and a short consumer-facing release notes draft. Keep this as the single-plane source for the 48-72h microwindow runbook and for seeding the final release notes.

When to use this playlist
- Small feature gates (<5% traffic or behind explicit feature flag).
- Quick model or config swaps (no schema changes, no DB migrations).
- Capacity/infra fixes that require short throttled traffic shifts.
- Must be scheduled midweek (Tue–Thu) in the 14:00–18:00 PT window to align with regional coverage.

Objectives (high level)
1) Maintain <5% user-facing error-rate delta and <10ms median latency delta for the rolled routes.
2) Verify telemetry gates and health checks at 1m / 5m / 30m cadence post-traffic-step.
3) Ship compact, clear release notes suitable for portal and support teams.

Planned calendar (seed)
- Day -3 (Fri): Announce microwindow intent to product, SRE, CS; open temp incident channel; attach test plans. Owner: Ravi.
- Day -2 (Mon): Finalize smoke test matrix, pin build artifact, tag image: ri/microwindow/2027-09-xx. Owner: Lin.
- Day -1 (Tue morning): Dry-run in staging with canary traffic pattern. Confirm rollback script accessible. Owner: Ava.
- Day 0 (Tue 15:00 PT): Rollout start. 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m steady windows. Owner: Release conductor.
- Day +1 (Wed 11:00 PT): Post-deploy 24h sweep; release notes review and CS briefing. Owner: Morgan.
- Day +3 (Fri): Close postmortem notes if all green else extend window. Owner: Ava.

Preflight checklist (must complete before Day 0)
- [ ] Confirm SLA/maintenance windows (calendar invites sent to stakeholders). Ticket: JIRA-RI-4021.
- [ ] Pin model/artifact SHA and store in release-row with signatures.
- [ ] Smoke test scenarios created and reviewed (list at linked_artifacts).
- [ ] Fallback variant validated: compatible earlier model or config.
- [ ] Rollback scripts in repo and validated runbook steps.
- [ ] Observability: dashboards created (latency, error-rate, qps, cpu, mem), alerts tuned for microwindow.
- [ ] Capacity: ensure spare GPU/instance pool for instant scale up.
- [ ] Security: no new secrets or permissions in the change.

Day-of runbook (concise)
- 15:00 PT: Kickoff in temporary Slack channel (create thread). Confirm owners + on-call present.
- 15:05: Start first step: route 5% traffic. Confirm health checks green for 2x p50 windows.
- 15:15: Evaluate metrics: p50/p95 latency, error-rate, token-cost anomaly. If OK -> proceed.
- 15:25: Increase to 20%. Hold 10m. Re-evaluate.
- 15:40: Increase to 50% if previous holds. Hold 15m.
- 16:00: To 100% if stable. Begin 30m monitoring sweep.
- On any threshold breach (see Triggers below) -> rollback immediately to previous stable variant and notify CS + SRE.

Rollback and abort triggers
- Error-rate spike > 3x baseline sustained for 2 consecutive 1m windows.
- p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for 5m.
- Any customer-facing outage alerts in PagerDuty triggers.
- Token cost anomaly: per-token unit cost > 2x expected for sustained 10m.
- Manual abort from product or SRE.

Telemetry and post-deploy sampling
- Short window metrics: sample 1000 requests per minute for first 30m; map to prompt size buckets.
- Logging: increase verbose sampling for the first 5 failing requests per route (capped for PII).
- Core dashboards to watch: route-latency, route-errors, kv-cache-hit-rate, batch-size-distribution, model-memory-pressure.

Quick release notes draft (consumer-facing, short)
Title: Small routing & efficiency update (rolled out 2027-09-xx)
Summary: Today we rolled out a small routing optimization and model config tweak designed to reduce tail latency on short prompts and improve cost-per-token on high-frequency routes. No user data migration or client changes are required.
Impact: Expected: negligible disruption. Improvements: ~5–10% p95 latency improvement on supportive routes.
If you see issues: Contact support via help@redwood.ai and reference Release RI-4021.

Internal release notes (for CS + Escalations)
- Build: ri/microwindow/2027-09-xx (SHA: abcdef12345).
- Routes affected: /v1/generate (short-prompt bucket), /v1/chat (system prompt optimization).
- Rollout schedule: 15:00 PT stepwise to 100% by 16:00 PT.
- Rollback plan: revert route config to variant v2027-08-29.
- Observability anchors: dashboard link (confluence stub) and PagerDuty escalation policy ID: PD-RI-CORE.

Post-deploy followups
- 24h: Run regression evals (prompt set A) and publish diffs to /internal/evals/microwindow-2027-09. Owner: Research.
- 72h: Cost delta analysis, annotate billing dashboards. Owner: Finance-ops.
- 7d: Decide retention for telemetry sampling and close the temporary channel.

Open questions & risks
- Does the 10m hold time give sufficient signal for bursty routes? Might need 20m on routes with high retry rates.
- Is the fallback variant validated across all regions? We have coverage for NA/EU but need explicit checks for APAC.
- Do we need a top-of-stack comms note to the partners team? Potential small change to embedding pipelines may affect third-party consumers.

Notes to self (informal)
- Keep release notes tight; avoid technical detail that confuses CS customers.
- For internal briefings, include a 1-paragraph summary, and attach diff graphs.
- Mark the runbook with specific person names before go-time (no "release conductor" generic tag).

Action items (short)
- Ava: Run staging dry-run Tue morning and capture smoke log.
- Lin: Attach signed artifact and push tag to release-row.
- Ravi: Confirm calendar invites + PD escalation are set.
- Morgan: Draft consumer-facing release notes and CS briefing doc.

Revision history
- 2027-09-14: Initial sketch (Ava)
- 2027-09-17: Added rollback triggers + telemetry sampling notes (Ravi)
- 2027-09-20: Updated calendar times and collaborators (Morgan)

End of seed playlist.

(If this turns into the canonical microwindow runbook, move to confluence and mark status: final.)
